roles.name: Legal
roles.qualifications: Essential: LL.B.; at least two years relevant work experience; basic intellectual-property law knowledge; effective, clear verbal and written communication; ability to meet strict deadlines and work under pressure. LL.M. or related law Master's and prior intellectual-property work are desirable.
roles.salary: ₹90,000–₹1,20,000 per month, inclusive of applicable taxes; no other facility or allowance.
roles.languageNote: Legal notice requires clear verbal and written communication but names no mandatory language or standardized proficiency level. Form asks languages known with proficiency; that field alone adds no language criterion.

roles.name: Trade
roles.qualifications: Essential: Master's in economics, agricultural economics, international trade or related field; at least two years post-Master's work experience in relevant discipline, including Tableau, Power BI or similar visualization tools and proficiency in spreadsheets and presentation suites. Market intelligence, data analysis, agriculture and market-access experience is desirable.
roles.salary: ₹80,000–₹1,05,000 per month, inclusive of applicable taxes; no other facility or allowance.
roles.languageNote: Trade notice states no mandatory language or standardized proficiency level. Form asks languages known with proficiency; that field alone adds no language criterion.
